Test fixtures: origins and licences.

musers_athena_fw3.1.19_p1041.hex
  Copied unmodified from muse-rs (https://github.com/eugenehp/muse-rs), tests/fixtures/,
  commit 0293bc7. Copyright 2026 Eugene Hauptmann. Licensed under the Apache License 2.0
  (http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0). Recorded by the muse-rs author from a
  Muse S Athena, firmware 3.1.19, preset p1041.

openmuse_*.txt
  The first 60-120 lines of the files of the same name (without the prefix) in OpenMuse
  (https://github.com/DominiqueMakowski/OpenMuse), tests/test_data/, commit a9be252.
  Declared MIT in OpenMuse's pyproject.toml classifiers (the repository has no LICENSE file
  and names no copyright holder; repository owner: Dominique Makowski). MIT terms:
    Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy of this
    software and associated documentation files, to deal in the Software without restriction,
    subject to including the copyright notice and this permission notice in all copies or
    substantial portions of the Software. THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY
    OF ANY KIND.
  Format per line: ISO arrival time <TAB> characteristic UUID <TAB> notification bytes in hex.

*.ref.json
  Generated by ../tools/make_reference.py from the files above, by running both OpenMuse's
  decode.py and muse-rs's parse.rs on every notification and checking that they agree.
